name: Gitea
summary: Self-hosted Git service, release line 28 (v28.3.0): install, admin, app.ini config cheat sheet, CLI, Actions + Gitea Runner 5.x, packages, webhooks, REST API (Swagger 2 + OpenAPI 3), 28.x release notes.
license: Docs: Apache-2.0 (gitea/docs repo). API spec and release notes: MIT (go-gitea/gitea).

sources.url: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/releases (v28.0.0, v28.1.0, v28.2.0, v28.3.0, via gh release view)

coverage: All English Gitea 28 docs as served on docs.gitea.com (installation, administration, usage, development, help; 99 pages), Gitea Runner 5.x docs (16 pages), the full v28.3.0 REST API spec in Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0 with generated per-tag endpoint pages (537 operations) and schema page, and release notes v28.0.0-v28.3.0.
gaps: Enterprise docs (/enterprise/ on docs.gitea.com) are built from a separate repository and are not included
gt (Gitea CLI client) docs not included: the docs repo has no released version of them yet, only 'develop'
Gitea Runner docs are the 5.x series only (latest 5.2.0); older runner series 0-4 not included
Older Gitea changelogs (1.x) and the Gitea blog are not included; only 28.x release notes
The docs are taken from the main branch of the docs repo (the frozen version-28 folder), not from a tag; the docs repo is not tagged per release
notes: Constraint 'gitea 28 or later' read as the newest stable release >= 28: v28.3.0 (Gitea renumbered from 1.27.x to 28.0.0). docs.gitea.com versions its docs per release line ('28'), so the folder is '28' and the exact release is recorded in 'release'. go-gitea/docs on GitHub is an archived 2017 Hugo repo; the current docs source is gitea.com/gitea/docs (Astro/Starlight). The site's release placeholders (@version@, @dockerVersion@, @sourceVersion@, @sourceBranch@, @minGoVersion@, @minNodeVersion@) were substituted with the '28' values from packages/content-loader/src/products.ts in that repo. API specs kept byte-for-byte; the generated Markdown was built with tools/openapi2md.py --version 28.3.0 --base-path /api/v1. Sidebar _category_.json files were dropped.
